title: Founding Sprint
purpose: Turn the public Commons into a body of independently reviewable Navier-Stokes work while simultaneously stress-testing the collaboration protocol.
launch_rule: The workspace may be published before these quests are complete. Completion changes the evidence state of the project; it does not retroactively authorize publication.
success_conditions: At least one independent source or formal reproduction is submitted.
At least one mathematically substantive or semantic review artifact is submitted.
At least one public-science, visualization, accessibility, browser, or agent-evaluation artifact is submitted.
Every accepted artifact records exact scope, evidence, limitations, provenance, and reviewer class.
No accepted scientific claim is elevated solely by the contributor who authored it.
